subject: Evaluation playbook: AtlasPay security milestones and MAP
messages:
From: Emily Santos <emily.santos@atlaspay.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: MAP + security gates for AtlasPay POC

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — AtlasPay's product and latency profile look promising. Procurement asked me to get a concrete mutual action plan (MAP) and the list of security/compliance gates we need to satisfy before a pilot goes live. Their specific asks: SOC 2 evidence, completed SIG/CAIQ, executed DPA with data retention language, and confirmation on encryption/keys.

Can you share a MAP with milestones and rough timelines so legal and procurement can triage? We are hoping to start the pilot in the week of Feb 22 if we can get the paperwork and checklist completed.

Attaching the procurement intake doc they sent.

Best,
Emily
Emily Santos
Head of Integrations | AtlasPay
emily.santos@atlaspay.com
+1 (415) 555-0148

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, KarThik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: MAP + security gates for AtlasPay POC

Emily — thanks for the clear asks. I've sketched an evaluation playbook/MAP and included the high-level security/compliance gates below. I attached a MAP template you can drop into your tracker (Redwood_MAP_Template.xlsx).

High-level MAP (proposed):
- Week 0 (Feb 10–14): Intake & kickoff — finalize scope, data flows, production vs test data.
- Week 1 (Feb 15–21): Compliance evidence exchange — provide SOC 2 (redacted), SIG/CAIQ partial answers, and initial DPA draft.
- Week 2 (Feb 22–28): Legal review & DPA negotiations; procurement issues PO if needed.
- Week 3 (Mar 1–7): Pilot provisioning and verification; security acceptance checklist sign-off.

Security/compliance gates (must-haves before pilot):
- SOC 2 Type II (latest report available; redacted evidence OK for eval).
- Completed SIG/CAIQ matrix (we can provide partial answers up front and finish during Week 1).
- Executed DPA with agreed retention and deletion commitments. Default retention options: 30 days (ephemeral), 1 year, or 5 years — we can propose 1 year as standard for pilot.
- Proof of encryption at rest and in transit; KMS integration available for enterprise plans.
- Audit log access and SLA for evidence requests during evaluation.

Next steps: I can loop in Compliance (Neha) to surface SOC 2 and SIG artifacts and Legal (KarThik) for the DPA redline. If that timeline works, I will send a single PDF MAP + links to the artifacts by end of day.

Would you prefer the DPA via DocuSign or a native redline?

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Attachment: Redwood_MAP_Template.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Santos <emily.santos@atlaspay.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: KarThik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: MAP + security gates for AtlasPay POC

Emily/Jasmine — looping in Compliance + Ops details. Quick answers to the items you listed: 

1) SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report covering Security and Availability for the 2026 audit period. We can share a redacted copy for procurement review and provide an evidence bundle on an NDA if requested. Attachment: SOC2-Report-2026-redacted.pdf.

2) SIG/CAIQ: We maintain a live SIG matrix. The partial answers document is attached (SIG-CAIQ-partial-answers.xlsx). We can complete outstanding sections within 48–72 hours once you flag any high-priority controls.

3) DPA: We use a standard DPA template that covers subprocessor lists, security measures, and deletion/retention options. We accept reasonable redlines on jurisdiction and liability; exceptions will need Legal review. Attachment: Redwood_DPA_v1_redline.pdf (redline).

4) Data retention & deletion: For pilots, recommended default retention is 30 days (ephemeral). For customers that require longer retention for audit/logging, we support up to 5 years under dedicated contracts. We can offer a 1-year retention setting for AtlasPay's pilot if that aligns with your compliance needs.

5) Encryption & keys: Data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest. We support customer-managed keys via KMS for Dedicated/Private plans.

If AtlasPay's legal team has a specific clause or retention period they must meet, please send it over and we will flag it early.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Compliance | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Attachment: SOC2-Report-2026-redacted.pdf (pdf); SIG-CAIQ-partial-answers.xlsx (xlsx); Redwood_DPA_v1_redline.pdf (pdf)

From: Rajesh Patel <rajesh.patel@atlaspay.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: legal@atlaspay.com
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evaluation playbook: AtlasPay security milestones and MAP

Thanks for the quick responses. A few clarifications from our procurement/legal: 

- Timeline: Our goal is to have contract and DPA signed by Feb 18 to allow a go-live pilot week of Feb 22. Is that realistic on your side?
- Retention: AtlasPay policy requires a maximum retention of 12 months for vendor-managed logs unless an exception is approved. Can you commit to 12 months for the pilot?
- DPA signature: Legal prefers DocuSign for speed. Can you send the DPA via DocuSign with your redline applied?
- SIG: We will mark controls around data residency and access control as high-priority. Please surface any live evidence for those controls.

If you can confirm timelines and share the DocuSign link, I will route to our legal for a rapid review.

Rajesh Patel
Sr. Manager, Procurement | AtlasPay
rajesh.patel@atlaspay.com
